data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (BOOK > Map search, enter origin, set dates mode, Search, open the list of results) and covers origin and flexible dates, but it adds a trip_type and max_price that weren't in the true workflow, and it leaves the search type and the date selection vague, so an automation would need guesses on some steps.
